acceptance_mapping.exclusion_reason: Owner instruction on 2026-10-09: "Human standard user test is out of scope for this project" (D25). No Windows 10 host was tested. PRODUCT_SPEC makes this optional; Windows 11 desktop and hosted Server tests do not establish Windows 10 validation. Excluded from validated v1.0.0 support in README and docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.

No live UNC network share was tested. Local NTFS runs and UNC string unit tests do not establish network-share connectivity, permissions or native operation. Excluded from validated v1.0.0 support in README and docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.

No ARM or 32-bit host was tested. The required reference uses x64; an x86 PDFtk executable on an x64 host does not validate other host architectures. Excluded from validated v1.0.0 support in README and docs/COMPATIBILITY.md.
